jobs.name: smoke_rwkv7
jobs.cmd: export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1; for n in 20 30; do {python} -m torch.distributed.run --nproc_per_node 2 --master_port 29511 train.py --base_model fla-hub/rwkv7-0.4B-g1a --out_dir outputs/{name} --max_steps $n --batch_size 8 --grad_accum 1 --warmup_steps 5 --eval_every 10 --eval_windows 16 --eval_long_windows 8 --log_every 5 --save_every 10 || exit 1; done --wandb_project recurrent-armt
